title: API Hello Launchpad: compact onboarding screenshot bundle
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Design set for a compact, progressive onboarding flow aimed at first-time API users. This ticket contains a curated bundle of screenshots and assets for the Hosted API getting-started docs: model selector (compact grid with capability badges), request builder (preset intents and parameter hinting), inline code snippets (curl / python / node toggles), and a small prompt library carousel. Focus is on a single-page Launchpad that scales from 320px to desktop and reduces cognitive load by progressive disclosure of advanced options.
acceptance_criteria: Finalized screenshot set (desktop, tablet, mobile) exported at 2x and 3x sizes and uploaded to Drive
Model selector visual shows capability badges (Latency / Cost / Creativity) and tooltips that match runtime telemetry labels
Request builder shows 3 preset intents with quick-fill buttons and a visible token-estimate microcopy
Code snippet toggle works for curl, python, node and includes copy button in screenshot annotations
All images pass basic a11y contrast checks and alt text provided in asset metadata
tasks: Add alt text and short captions for each image (Aisha)
Run quick a11y contrast audit and document exceptions (Design Ops)
Sync with PM to confirm final copy for token estimate microcopy (PM review)
Upload final assets to docs repo and update markdown snippets (Docs owner)
comments: 2026-02-12 - Initial exploration: created three layout variants. Decided to use compact card grid for model selection to reduce vertical scroll.
2026-02-20 - PM feedback (O. Martinez): prefer showing recommended model first with the option to expand 'All models' — updated mockups accordingly.
2026-02-25 - Eng review (S. Huang): request builder needs a small network latency meter placeholder; backend will expose 'probe_latency' flag in runtime-1.18. Added callout in designs.
2026-03-02 - Usability test: 6 participants. Key finding: users look for example prompts before tuning parameters. Added a prompt library carousel above request builder.
2026-03-07 - QA notes: code toggle copy button overlays the line numbers on small widths; adjusted layout to place copy button in header.
2026-03-09 - PR created for docs update: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/814 — awaiting review.
design_notes: Prefer single-column flow on mobile with collapsible advanced section to keep screenshots scannable.
Model capability badges are derived from runtime telemetry: latency / cost / creativity. Badge colors should match Console palette; include dashed outline for experimental models.
Token estimate uses a lightweight microcopy and a tooltip; avoid exposing raw token counts for non-dev docs users — show 'approx.' language.
Accessibility: all interactive states must be represented in at least one screenshot (hover, focus, active) for developers who need to reproduce UI states in docs.
Export checklist: include filename convention, export scale, and ALT text in the Drive upload spreadsheet.
